entry.title: Agent-memory loop vs Cogni LangGraph+Dolt: stage-by-stage gap scorecard
entry.content:
**Use when:** prioritizing work at the LangGraph↔knowledge-hub seam, or evaluating any 'give agents memory' proposal against what already exists.

External blueprint (cyrilXBT agent-memory threads, Aug 2026): agent memory = **Write → Consolidate → Recall → Apply**; a typed knowledge graph (**extract → resolve → assemble → query → repeat**) is the shared multi-agent memory — workers write to it, evaluators fact-check against it, overnight loops persist with it.

Stage-by-stage vs Cogni (verified at repo sha `3098f2a`, 2026-08-12):

| Stage | Us | Optimal | Gap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Assemble (typed graph) | `citations` DAG: 9 edge types, provenance + confidence per row, Dolt-versioned, branch contributions with per-commit attribution | canonical nodes, typed edges, provenance | **ahead of blueprint** (versioning it doesn't ask for) |
| Write | knowledge_write on 4/13 graphs (`brain`, `autoresearch-*`); manual tool call | every graph's durable output lands as atoms + edges | `research` graph (only real StateGraph) discards all findings at `final_report`; 9/13 graphs cannot write |
| Recall | flat text `core__knowledge_search`, edge-less results; RECALL_BEFORE_WRITE is prompt text on the human-CLI plane only | recall step in the graph runtime injecting top-k merged atoms before acting | 9/13 graphs cannot recall at all; zero runtime enforcement |
| Apply | prompt discipline | recalled lessons demonstrably shape next action | unmeasured, unenforced |
| Query (subgraph) | 1-hop `listCitationsBy*` only; `/api/v1/knowledge/graph` 403 for Bearer agents | serialize a bounded subgraph; answers cite edges | DAG is written and rendered, never traversed at recall time |
| Consolidate | REFINE_OVER_EXTEND as skill discipline; confidence recompute aspirational | scheduled distill/dedupe loop | no runtime loop |
| Resolve (dedup) | unique (citing, cited, type) index; skills warn against islands | alias clustering | manual only |
| Extract | agents author curated atoms | auto entity/S-P-O extraction | **deliberate divergence — keep**; the syntropy bar beats auto-triples |

**Conclusion:** the data plane exceeds the blueprint; the agent runtime is unplugged from it. LangGraph layer is 12/13 single-node `createReactAgent`, no checkpointer, no Store, `stateKey` ignored InProc. Memory work should wire graphs to the existing DAG (recall step, research write-back, edge-aware search) — **not** add a parallel memory substrate (LangGraph Store / separate vector memory), which would fragment memory and bypass provenance + syntropy gates.

Source: x.com/cyrilXBT/status/2082338580827873476 (graph-engineering thread) + /status/2070091386482020852 (write/consolidate/recall/apply); repo evidence `packages/langgraph-graphs/src/catalog.ts`, `packages/knowledge-base/src/schema.ts:142`, `packages/knowledge-store/src/port/knowledge-store.port.ts:209-220`, `nodes/operator/app/src/app/api/v1/cognition/_bundle.ts:35`. Implementation tracked by the 'wire LangGraph agents into the knowledge DAG' story filed 2026-08-12 (link via `tracks` citation after merge).
